title: Grouping transition table entries by state
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let a transition table assign an action to each state in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, each input read in $\{\text{blank},0,1\}$, and each tuple of $k$ work-tape reads in $\{\text{blank},0,1\}^k$. The bit string encoding the table is the concatenation, in state order, of the action encodings for each state, with that state's entries ordered by input read and then by work-tape read tuple.
hypotheses_covered: A transition table on states, input reads, and work-tape read tuples
